description:
In 2009, a time when the analog and digital worlds were intertwining and colliding. In Busan during that time lived an ordinary high school sophomore named Eo-Jin, whose true identity was Lee Jeong-Dok, a famous figure on the internet. She was a well-known fanfiction writer for “Armageddon,” one of the top idol groups of 2009. Lee Jeong-Dok had been active while hiding her true identity from everyone. However, her identity was discovered by none other than Nam Ju-Yeon, the younger brother of Armageddon member Ji-Hyeok...

Nam Ju-Yeon uses this as leverage to blackmail her. Will Eo-Jin be able to keep her secret safe amidst Nam Ju-Yeon’s blackmail...? 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
